text:
Maria Santos: Hey team — need a short (single-page) brief for enterprise buyers that compares deploy modes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) and highlights SLAs, security controls, and how inbound leads map to sales tracks. We need a PDF for the webinar landing page + a 1-slide snapshot for field. Anyone own a draft? cc @Alex

Alex Kim: I can whip up a draft. Proposed structure: TL;DR, Decision checklist, SLA & security highlights, Routing & lead flow. Will post a first pass here by EOD.

Samir Patel: For lead routing — recommend buckets: "Self-serve", "Growth", "Enterprise". Map to touchpoints: email nurture, AE outreach, solutions consult. Also include expected MQL signals (usage, org size, security interest) + a webhook sample for the inbound flow.

Alex Kim: First-pass copy below — skim for tone/accuracy.

Alex Kim: ```
TL;DR
Redwood Inference gives teams predictable inference across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments so security-conscious enterprises get both performance and control. This brief helps buyers pick the right deploy mode and explains how inbound leads should be routed to the right sales motion.

Decision checklist
- Hosted: fastest time-to-value, pay-as-you-go, best for proofs-of-concept and low-regulated data.
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools, predictable throughput + SLA, good for medium-to-high scale.
- Private: VPC/on-prem with KMS/HSM, audit logs, air-gapped options for regulated workloads.

Security & compliance snapshot
- Network: VPC peering, private endpoints, tenant isolation
- Data protection: KMS/HSM integration, configurable data retention, audit logs
- Certifications: SOC2 + enterprise audit support, optional on-prem package

SLA highlights (example)
- Dedicated: 99.95% uptime SLA, latency SLOs configurable per model/route
- Private: contractable SLAs + custom runbooks for deployments
- Hosted: SLA available for enterprise tier; self-serve without SLA

Inbound lead routing (example mapping)
- Self-serve -> marketing nurture (email automation)
- Growth -> AE + solutions engagement (scheduled demo)
- Enterprise -> field alert + security/arch deep-dive session

Webhook sample
```json
{
  "lead_id": "{{lead.id}}",
  "interest": "private",
  "score": "85",
  "route": "enterprise"
}
```

CTAs
- Request a private proof-of-concept
- Schedule an SLA & security review
```

Samir Patel: Love it. For routing, add thresholds: e.g., sustained 1M tokens/day OR explicit checkbox for "Requires HIPAA/SOC2" => route to Enterprise. I'll drop a small diagram (PNG) in the thread.

Olivia Zhang: Great copy. Suggest CTA variants for testing: "Request a private proof-of-concept" vs "Start an architecture review". Also can we include one short benchmark stat on cost/latency gains for Dedicated with caching+quantization? Might help conversions.

Samir Patel: Internal bench: typical chat workloads saw ~37-43% token-cost reduction when enabling prefix KV cache + int8 quantization on Dedicated vs baseline. I'll attach the measurement note and a simple bar stat.

Alex Kim: Updated the brief with CTAs and the stat. Exporting PDF + 1-slide snapshot tomorrow AM. @deploy-bot can you create a docs PR for the collateral?

deploy-bot: Created PR #452 for marketing collateral — draft/enterprise-deploy-snapshot.md (https://github.com/redwood/marketing/pull/452) :white_check_mark: 

Maria Santos: Perfect. Final asks: keep the PDF to one page, include Samir's routing diagram, add the two CTA variations for the landing page A/B test, and make the slide a single visual with the decision checklist on the left and SLAs/stats on the right. Target publish to the webinar landing by Friday COB. :rocket:

Alex Kim: On it — will ping when assets are ready. :thumbsup:
